result.summary: The environment is a wide, multi-lane arterial road with sidewalks on both sides, though the pedestrian experience is degraded by long crossing distances and large setbacks with surface parking. While sidewalks are in good condition, the scale of the roadway and frequent driveway curb cuts create a high-speed, vehicle-oriented atmosphere.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to cross a wide expanse of asphalt, increasing exposure to high-speed traffic.

hazards.name: Frequent Driveway Conflict Points
hazards.description: Multiple curb cuts for parking lot access on the left side create numerous points where vehicles cross the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Install raised median islands at crossing points to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at intersections or mid-block crossings to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Implement continental or ladder-style markings to increase the visibility of pedestrian crossing areas to approaching motorists.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features continuous sidewalks along a wide multi-lane arterial with street lighting and trees. Safety is compromised by frequent driveway curb cuts for parking lots and a lack of mid-block crossing infrastructure or medians. The environment is dominated by vehicle-oriented land uses, resulting in a fragmented streetscape with limited natural surveillance.

hazards.name: Multiple driveway curb cuts
hazards.description: Frequent vehicle access points across the sidewalk for parking lots increase the risk of pedestrian-vehicle conflicts.

hazards.name: Wide roadway crossing
hazards.description: The multi-lane configuration and lack of a median refuge increase exposure time for pedestrians crossing the street.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the nearby intersection to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Reduce the number of curb cuts to minimize conflict points between pedestrians and turning vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Implement continental-style markings at the intersection to increase driver awareness.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban arterial street with multi-story mixed-use buildings and well-maintained, wide sidewalks. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like marked crosswalks and curb ramps are present, the significant road width and lack of mid-crossing refuge increase pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four travel lanes plus parking lanes without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection across the main roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corner can block sight lines between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb line near the intersection

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Replace standard transverse lines with continental or ladder-style markings to increase the visibility of the crossing to approaching motorists.

result.summary: The environment features wide sidewalks with street trees and lighting, providing a decent pedestrian experience. However, the presence of a gas station with multiple wide curb cuts creates significant conflict points between pedestrians and vehicles, and the overall roadway width suggests higher traffic speeds.

hazards.name: Wide Driveway Conflict Points
hazards.description: Multiple wide curb cuts for the gas station create frequent areas where vehicles cross the pedestrian walkway at potentially high speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, spanning the gas station frontage

hazards.name: Lack of Mid-block Crossing
hazards.description: Despite the presence of a bus stop and residential buildings, there is no marked crossing visible, which may encourage unsafe mid-block crossings.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the number and width of curb cuts for the gas station to minimize conflict points and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked mid-block crossing with a pedestrian refuge island and high-visibility markings to facilitate safe crossing near the bus stop.
